about: Owner decisions for docs/DMF-UI-SHADCN-PARITY.json. Each key is an item id from that record (an id ending in * covers every id with that prefix) and each value is the reason the difference is intentional. Keys starting with `measured.<property>:` cover a measured difference for a case or part id. A decision that no longer matches a difference fails `npm run shadcn:check`.

button.variants.size:md: Kept as an alias of default for existing consumers (DMF-UI-NOVA.md).
button.props.Button.as: Astro polymorphism: DMF UI renders <a> or <button> through `as` (and `href`) instead of Base UI's `render` prop.
button.measured.color:button/Button?variant=des: Destructive text mixes a fifth of the foreground into --destructive, keeping 4.5:1 on its tint where Nova's text-destructive gives about 4:1 (button-variants.ts).

kbd.measured.color:kbd/*: Kbd keeps foreground text: Nova's muted-foreground on bg-muted is about 4.4:1 in Neutral, below AA for its 12px text.

tabs.stateHooks:data-active: DMF UI styles the active trigger with data-[state=active]; the data-active custom variant (upstream/shadcn.css) matches it too, so Nova's classes apply as they are.

field.stateHooks:data-checked: Field styles a checked choice with has-[[data-checked],:checked], which covers native inputs as well as data-checked.
field.props.Field.as: Astro polymorphism: DMF UI renders another element through `as`, where Base UI uses `render`.

checkbox.stateHooks:data-checked: DMF UI's Checkbox is a native input, styled through :checked.

checkbox.props.Checkbox.indeterminate: Server-renders the mixed state; a small script sets the native input's indeterminate property. Base UI accepts the same prop through its spread.
checkbox.dataAttributes:data-indeterminate: Carries the indeterminate prop to the script that sets the native property.

button-group.slots:button-group-text: DMF UI marks ButtonGroupText with a data-slot so parents can style it; shadcn's renders through useRender without one.

button-group.props.ButtonGroupSeparator.decorative: Chooses between role=separator and a presentational divider, as DMF UI's Separator does; Base UI's Separator always exposes role=separator.

input.props.Input.type: DMF UI passes `type` straight through as a native attribute; shadcn names it only to forward it to Base UI.

input-group.props.InputGroup.label: Names the group in one prop (aria-label on role=group); shadcn leaves naming to the consumer.

select.measured.backgroundColor:select/compound: DMF UI keeps opaque menus. Nova's source marks the popup cn-menu-translucent: a 70% background with a backdrop blur.
Nova's translucent menu rule draws separators in foreground/5; DMF UI's opaque menu uses --border, as Nova's own separator rule does.
The open DMF list highlights the selected item, as Base UI focuses it on open; the static reference is not focused.
select.measured.color:select/compound#select-it: The open DMF list highlights the selected item, as Base UI focuses it on open; the static reference is not focused.
select.measured.width:select/compound#select-se: A measuring artifact: Nova's popup takes its width from Base UI's --anchor-width, which the static reference has no trigger to set, so it spans the whole column.
